jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Backend
jobs.content:
About the role

One of the first backend engineering managers on the Databricks India team in Bengaluru, building infrastructure for resource management and cloud-agnostic services.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience with large-scale distributed systems
  • Extensive experience as a software engineering leader building teams from the ground up
  • Experience managing a team of strong software engineers
  • BS or higher in Computer Science or a related field
